title: Body fat
caption: Stubborn body fat is the kind that won't budge no matter how clean you eat or how often you train - usually the lower belly, flanks, inner thighs, or under the chin. It's not the same problem as weight loss: that pad of fat is largely genetic and stays in roughly the same pattern even as the rest of your body changes. Non-surgical clinic treatments target THESE specific pockets, while lifestyle keeps your overall weight steady. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
